card.name: Start of a brand drug name
card.fires_on: The first piece of a brand-name drug that is split into several pieces, such as Optimark, Retrovir, Neuroforte, Norpace or MultiHance. It appears right after a generic name, a list comma, or 'and'.

modes.label: Brand after 'and' or comma
modes.description: First piece of a brand name in a list of products or interacting drugs.
modes.example: At equivalent doses, gadolinium retention varies among the linear agents with Omniscan (gadodiamide) and<< Optim>>ark (gadoversetamide)

modes.label: Brand after a label
modes.description: First piece of a brand name after 'Brand Name:' or in parentheses after a generic name.
modes.example: Drugs A - Z Generic Name: cyanocobalamin | Brand Name:<< Neuro>>forte-R CategoryHerbs &

modes.label: Brand with trademark symbol
modes.description: Middle or first piece of a brand name followed by ® in a list of products.
modes.example: Pargyline HCL and methyclothiazide E<<utron>> ® (Abbott Laboratories) Phenel

card.writes: It promotes product-style name endings such as Glide, Navigator, EZ and Sure, which suggests a brand name is being completed.
card.plain: It marks the opening piece of a brand-name drug that is still being spelled out.
